== Title ==
<span lang="ja">もうだめだ！</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ライフフォースが15より小さいときの相手の支配フェイズに使用できる。場に出す。このターンの残りの間、フォースを失う毎に、失うフォースの数を半分にする（端数切り上げ）。Ｒ２－Ｄ２かＣ－３ＰＯが場に出ていれば、端数切り捨て。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">３ＰＯは、数多くの災難に脅かされ、たびたび作動停止の危機に見舞われた。この不運な通訳ドロイドは、罪のない皮肉感覚が発達し、状況判断力も鋭くなった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[We're Doomed]].

'''Lore''' — 3PO has been threatened by many calamities and often faced shutdown. The luckless interpreter droid developed an innocent sense of irony and sharp situational judgment.

'''Game text''' — Play during the opponent's control phase if Life Force is below 15. For the rest of the turn, halve each Force loss (round up). If R2-D2 or C-3PO is on table, round down.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore uses 通訳ドロイド and 罪のない皮肉感覚 rather than protocol droid and cynicism. Game text names 支配フェイズ and 端数切り上げ / 端数切り捨て.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-weredoomed.gif|Original English face]], [[We're Doomed]].</ref>
